name: Hanime1
notes: Test40 is a performance hotfix after Test39 device evidence. Test39 search is confirmed working, but profile resolution introduced a re-entrant P.profile -> sessionProfile32 -> C.activeAccount -> browserProfile -> P.profile cycle and account playlist discovery could issue many sequential detail requests. Test40 keeps Test39 search/reply/filter/account parsing fixes, makes profile reads cache-only on ordinary pages, performs controlled profile sync only in My/Account, caches account sections, and makes playlist discovery single-request by default with explicit completion for unresolved metadata. Stable 2.0.0/Build20029 remains frozen.
